name: United Credit Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1991, United Credit Ltd is in the business of Financing and Renting.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
UCL is registered as the non-systematically important non deposit taking non-banking financial company. It earns its revenue from interest on loan and rent. The principal business of the company is hire-purchase, leasing, and consumer financing, real estate investments, equity trading, and capital market operations.
 The company has already started exploring possibilities in other areas like syndication corporate banking real estate and hotel 
industries so that the range of activities 
are expanded.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.56 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 5.18% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 3.97% over last 3 years.
